shots.what: hook: invites fly to five friends; the one without WhatsApp bounces back with a '?'

create: new event form, cover photo drops in, 'Share link' → one link fans out to all five friends
demo: the friend's phone opens the invite link (plain web page), taps RSVP, address appears; 'Install app?' tile struck out
Events Home: replies fly back, Going 0→5, reminder toggles on
limit: guest not replied yet (address locked, lock shakes) vs replied (address + pin)
availability: grid of phones lights up in waves, some still waiting; 'Rolling out to everyone' bar
CTA: hero pull-back, Media Diet sign
